name: Card
summary: A surface that groups one thing: a title, a body, a footer. Its border, radius, shadow and fill all come from the mood, so one card reads correctly in all thirty-two of them.
summaryZh: 把一件事圈起来的容器:标题、正文、页脚。描边、圆角、阴影和底色都来自 mood,所以同一张卡在三十多套主题里都读得对。

variants.name: Frosted
variants.note: Adds `.um-card--frosted`: the mood's backdrop filter. A mood without one declares none, so the class changes nothing there.

parts.name: Header
parts.note: The top strip. It carries the title and whatever acts on the card.

parts.name: Footer
parts.note: The bottom strip. It carries the actions.

props.name: variant
props.description: Which surface the card has. Without a variant the card is the mood's plain overlay surface.
props.descriptionZh: 卡片用哪种表面。不带变体就是 mood 的普通浮层表面。

a11y.notes: The card is a plain container and carries no role. Put a real heading in `.um-card__title` — the class sets the size, so the document outline stays right. If the whole card is meant to be clickable, put a link inside it instead of making the card a button: a clickable div is not focusable and is not announced as a control.
a11y.notesZh: 卡片就是一个普通容器,不带角色。`.um-card__title` 里请放真正的标题元素 —— 类已经定了字号,文档大纲不会乱。如果整张卡都是要点,就往里面放一个链接,别把卡片本身做成按钮:可点的 div 不可聚焦,读屏也不会把它当成控件。

examples.title: A card
examples.description: Header, body and footer are optional on their own, but the order is fixed: header, then body, then footer. The title is a heading, so the page keeps its outline.
examples.descriptionZh: 头部、正文、页脚各自都可以不写,但顺序是定的:头部,然后正文,然后页脚。标题用真正的标题元素,页面的大纲才不会乱。

examples.title: Frosted
examples.description: The frosted variant applies the mood's backdrop filter. A mood that has none declares `none`, so on that theme the class is invisible and the card looks the same as any other.
examples.descriptionZh: 磨砂变体应用该 mood 的背景模糊效果。没有这个效果的 mood 会声明 none,所以在那套主题里这个类看不出区别,卡片和别的卡一模一样。
examples.markup:
Glass

On a mood with a backdrop filter, the card blurs what is behind it.

notes: The frosted variant is a mood capability, not a card colour: it applies the theme's backdrop filter and changes nothing else. A mood without one declares `none`, so the hook is invisible there.
notesZh: 磨砂变体是 mood 的能力,不是卡片的颜色:它只应用主题的背景模糊,别的什么都不改。没有这个效果的 mood 会声明 none,所以那个钩子在那套主题里是看不见的。
